Nina: quick postmortem follow-up: last night's paging noise came from redis timeouts flapping on low-traffic shards. want to run a 48h noise-reduction experiment.
Ravi: saw it. 4 pages, all single-shard, no customer impact.
Sam: whats the proposal?
Nina: add a dedupe rule + threshold hold for low-volume shards: only page if breach persists on >=2 shards within 10m OR if error_rate * traffic > 0.5 (simple SNR proxy). otherwise create a ticket and log suppressed alert.
Ravi: how do we track suppressed alerts?
Nina: middleware will write to logs/alerts/suppressed and create ticket in ops with tag redis-noise.
Sam: rollout plan?
Nina: open PR today, canary to staging tomorrow, prod experiment starts Tue 07:00 UTC for 48h.
PagerBot: incident reference: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-501 (redis timeout spike 2026-03-20T02:14Z).
Ravi: owners: Nina -> rollout & dashboarding, Sam -> rollback steps + runbook. reconvene after experiment. :thumbsup:
